arguments.command:
cd /workspace/scratch && cat > runbig.py <<'EOF'
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, analyze as A
seed = int(sys.argv[1]); tight = sys.argv[2]=='1'
rng = random.Random(seed)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=tight)
inst = A._parse_request(req)
print('parsed S=%d C=%d E=%d obs=%d maxf=%d' % (len(inst['snapshots']), len(inst['commodities']),
      len(inst['edges']), sum(len(s[4]) for s in inst['snapshots']), inst['max_faults']), flush=True)
t0=time.time()
res = A.analyze(inst, req['id'])
print('total %.2f' % (time.time()-t0), res.get('status'), res.get('min_faults'), flush=True)
EOF
(timeout 175 python3 -u runbig.py 1 0 > big1.log 2>&1; echo exit=$? >> big1.log) & sleep 60; cat /workspace/scratch/big1.log
